[autotest] Select node after suspend to fix test flakiness There is a known issue that will cause the selected device changed after a suspend, which causing tests involving suspend flaky. We don't have any plan or schedule to fix the issue recently. This is a temp fix before the issue is address. This fix shouldn't hurt the purpose of the tests as all of them are about testing the audio functions after a suspend instead of the audio device selection. bluetooth: move property_handler_callback on ExportedObjectManagerWrapper Class ExportedObjectManagerWrapper has property_handler_setup_callback_ private property that can only be set through method SetPropertyHandlerSetupCallback(). The property is only used when the method AddExportedInterface() is called. This patch remove the property_handler_setup_callback_ property, and add a property_handler_setup_callback parameter to AddExportedInterface() instead. This is needed to allow ExportedObjectManagerWrapper to be shared by many components so that those components can freely define the property handler callbacks per object/interface. BUG=None TEST=Pass Test Change-Id: Iaa3668b7429d3fc344953e947520184744bccbc4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1712840 Tested-by: Archie Pusaka <apusaka@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Archie Pusaka <apusaka@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Miao-chen Chou <mcchou@chromium.org>

bluetooth: move dispatcher's object_manager This patch moves the ownership of exported_object_manager_wrapper of Dispatcher to DispatcherDaemon. This is to allows another module which is initiated by DispatcherDaemon to also have access to the exported_object_manager_wrapper. In the next patch this will be used to init a LoggingManager.
